verdict.rationale: Fivetran ships an official MCP server (github.com/fivetran/fivetran-mcp) that lets an agent query sync status read-only, and optionally unlock write/delete operations via FIVETRAN_SCOPE, plus manage connections — squarely matching the story. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the MCP server, and richer first-party documentation (e.g., official docs page rather than just a README) describing setup and supported clients.
